title: Like Some Kind Of Animal
style: 132 BPM progressive trance, tribal percussion under the kick, 336 Hz drone, vocal chops, building intensity, anthemic drop, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — tribal percussion, drone]
Like some kind of animal.
Focused.
Quiet.
Locked.

[Verse 1 — kick locks, percussion layered]
The animal in the chest doesn't argue.
The animal in the chest doesn't lie.
The animal waits for the perfect line.
Then the animal does or doesn't fly.

[Pre-Build — supersaw rises]
Read the room.
Read the chart.
Read the breath.
Read the heart.

[Build — full energy]
Now.
Now.
Now.
NOW.

[Drop — progressive anthem]
LIKE SOME KIND OF ANIMAL!
FOCUSED — STEADY — TRUE!
LIKE SOME KIND OF ANIMAL!
THE OPERATOR KNOWS WHAT TO DO!
The bull is the operator.
The animal is the will.
Like some kind of animal —
the catalog moves still.

[Verse 2 — drums fuller]
Forty years of staff in the hand.
Twenty-five years of tech in the land.
Pickleball court, pickleball ash.
The animal in every move and dash.

[Bridge — half-time]
Eyes wide.
Ground held.
Breath even.
Bull held.

[Final Drop — full progressive trance]
LIKE SOME KIND OF ANIMAL!
THE OPERATOR WAITS THEN MOVES!
LIKE SOME KIND OF ANIMAL!
THE WORK IS WHAT IT PROVES!
Release the line.
Release the swing.
Like some kind of animal —
the operator is the king.

[Outro — drone fades]
Like.
Some.
Kind.
Of.
Animal.
McIvor.
